0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home, 11th in the West, on a three-game losing streak) for the Nets' 11th game of the season. Egor Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise, and Nolan Traore is day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision. For New Orleans, Trendon Watford is out with an ankle injury, Yves Missi is out with a knee bruise, and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Nets' most recent meeting ended in a 116-113 loss in New Orleans.
